question: What long passage of time is attributed to the grace of śakti in this account?
premises: The grace of śakti is the cause.
A duration of a hundred thousand years is stated.
inference: By the grace of śakti, a hundred thousand years had then passed.
uncertainties: The subject of gataḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: O Goddess-lord, by the grace of śakti, a hundred thousand years had then passed.
